newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungarian overnight rates end flat at 20.75 pct.
newsitem.headline: Hungarian overnight rates end flat at 20.75 pct.

text.p: Hungary's overnight interest rates peaked at 21.125 percent on Thursday due to increased demand but retreated to close at 20.75 percent, unchanged from Wednesday, traders said.
"Two banks were taking up significant funds," said Sandor Tolonics of Commerzbank.

He added that this was probably due to client orders and it was the main reason why overnight rates remained relatively high compared with the central bank's benchmark one week reverse repo facility which stood at 20.25 percent.
